The '''Sith Infiltrator podracer''' was a racing [[Podracer/Legends|pod]] that resembled components of the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']] arranged in podracer form. It had faster acceleration, higher top speed, greater durability, better maneuverability, more efficient cooling, and was easier to repair than any other known podracer except the [[TIE Podracer]].
